title: AddVersionFromGitStreamlitRequest
description: Request body for adding a new version to a Streamlit from a Git tag or commit URI.

git_ref.description: Git reference URI. Accepts either a tag URI or a commit URI.

StreamlitVersionForGit.description: Version metadata for ADD VERSION from Git.

name.description: Name or alias for the new version.

comment.description: Optional comment associated with the pull.
